brand_summary: Afroviolin = the meeting point of classical violin elegance and vibrant West-African Afrobeat energy. Warm, cinematic, culturally rich, premium.

warm_cinematic.use: Default / soulful & emotional tracks (tributes, worship, calm)

camera_motion_presets.intimate_static: subtle breathing, shallow depth of field, slow push-in on violin strings
camera_motion_presets.energetic_orbit: slow orbit around the violinist, warm backlight, rhythmic light pulses on beat
camera_motion_presets.cinematic_pan: horizontal dolly, golden hour lighting, dust particles in light beams

recurring_visual_motifs: elegant violin (close-up of strings, bridge, scroll)
subtle Adinkra / Nsibidi inspired patterns as background texture
kente/ankara color accents woven into lighting and bokeh
abstract rhythmic particle waves synced to Afrobeat pulse

options.name: Option 1 — Cinematic Cultural Portrait
options.vibe: A solo violinist of African heritage performing in richly lit, cinematic spaces. Human, emotional, premium. Best for storytelling & tribute tracks.

options.vibe: Violin floating in abstract, particle-driven dreamscapes that pulse with the beat. Modern, looping-friendly, low-friction to mass produce. Best for batch/filler tracks.
